The '''''Galleon''''' was a [[sail barge]] composed of various old [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] vehicles that served as the headquarters of [[Kragan Gorr]]'s [[Warbird gang]] on [[Castilon]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Galleon'' was a [[sail barge]] that was built from various old vehicles from the [[Galactic Empire]]. [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] wings provided balance, its hull was created from a discarded [[All Terrain Armored Transport]], the crow's nest was built from a hollowed out [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] [[Limb|foot]], along with other parts.<ref name="Databank" /> The ''Galleon'' was also equipped with a [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="The Mutiny">{{Resistance|The Mutiny}}</ref>

The ''Galleon'' was equipped with several [[laser cannon]]s, and could accommodate [[swoop]]s, [[Warbird Skiff|skiff]]s, and [[Warbird starfighter|starfighter]]s that were also built from secondhand parts.<ref name="Databank" />

On the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the ''Galleon'', when Kragan sits on the captain's chair, it had the [[telescope]] to find a spot, even targeting for the [[Unidentified TIE fighter battalion|battalion]] of [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]]s.<ref name="A Quick Salvage Run">{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}}</ref>

The ''Galleon'' also had a [[hangar]]<ref name="Descent">{{Resistance|Descent (episode)}}</ref> for launching the [[skiff]]s to [[Mission to Celsor 3|hunt]] a [[jakoosk]] on the [[Water|ice]] [[moon]] [[Celsor 3]].<ref name="Hunt on Celsor 3">{{Resistance|Hunt on Celsor 3}}</ref>

==History==
In [[34 ABY]], the ''Galleon'' was on [[Castilon]] serving as the headquarters of Kragan Gorr and his [[pirate]] gang. During the [[Torra Doza's abduction]] from the ''[[Colossus]]'' station, the pirates [[Drell]] and [[Valik]] used a [[skiff]] to bring [[Torra Doza|Torra]] to the ''Galleon'' as they were pursued by [[Kazuda Xiono]] in the ''[[Fireball]]''.<ref name="Doza Dilemma" />

After the pirates arrived on the ''Galleon'' with Torra, Kazuda remained nearby not wanting to leave Torra. As a result, he was fired upon by the ''Galleon'', damaging the ''Fireball''. The [[First Order]], who was in league with the Warbird gang, arrived in an [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon''-class command shuttle]] to compensate the pirates for their success. However, [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] and his First Order [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] betrayed the pirates and rescued Torra, bringing her to the ''Colossus''.<ref name="Doza Dilemma" />

After the pirates had been betrayed by the First Order, they received a [[distress signal]] from the ''Colossus'' that according to Kazuda, the First Order had taken complete [[Occupation of the Colossus|control]] of the station, they were "under total lockdown and in danger" and send help immediately.<ref name="Descent" /> As the pirates received the message, they fight against the First Order to liberate the ''Colossus'' to get rid of the [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]]s, until the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'' have arrived, and Kaz ordered everyone (the [[Ace Squadron]] and Warbird gang) to retreat back to the ''Colossus'' to make a jump into [[hyperspace]].<ref name="No Escape 2">{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}}</ref>

The ''Galleon'' came up to the [[Unidentified icy asteroid|rendezvous point]] with the ship ''[[Meson Martinet]]'' led by [[Sidon Ithano]] of [[Sidon Ithano's pirate crew|his crew]] in the asteroid field. As he asked how the Crimson Corsair been faring of late, Sidon told him cut the pleasantries. Kragan was so pleased to see a [[B1's B2-series super battle droid battalion|battalion]] of [[B2-series super battle droid]]s, so he ordered Drell to give the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for the Crimson Corsair and with the battle droids can help his plan to [[Mutiny on the Colossus|take over the ''Colossus'']].<ref name="The Mutiny" />
